title: Mapping and transformation
explain: Graphical/XSLT/scripts transform messages; schema mismatch is a top failure. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Mapping and transformation" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Mapping and transformation, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Mapping and transformation without a failure story
howToApply: Use Mapping and transformation explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Mapping and transformation” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Mapping → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Mapping and transformation” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Mapping and transformation” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Mapping and transformation”.
